instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Web (Expo) project using pure StyleSheet. DO NOT USE Tailwind or CSS classes.

Implement a cohesive design integrating the 'Fresha' look (light clean backgrounds with vibrant Violet #5C33F6 accents for CTAs and active states) with CutSync's brand (Deep Green #2C4334 for top nav in desktop, major headings, and Cream #DAD2B6 for secondary backgrounds/badges).
Use Montserrat for headings (h1, h2, h3) and Inter for body text to keep the identity.

The Explore page should have a horizontal ScrollView for filter chips and a FlatList of Establishment Cards. Establishments cards must be touch-optimized with large tap targets, featuring a banner image, floating logo, and clear details.
Profile page needs a sticky 'Agendar agora' CTA at the bottom using safe area insets.
Implement responsive shell: if window width < 760px, render bottom navigation (icons + text). If >= 1040px, render a top navigation bar (deep green background).
Add 'testID' to all interactive elements for automated testing (e.g., testID='explore-search-input').
Ensure all buttons have active opacity or scale feedback using Pressable.
Do not use `transparent` background over content. Use solid or semi-transparent backgrounds with blur (where available in RN Web) for sticky headers/CTAs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize accessibility, ensuring high contrast between text and background.
Embrace generous spacing (padding/margin) to ensure a premium, uncluttered look.
Avoid centered layouts for lists/forms; left-align text for natural reading.
Use pill-shaped or soft-rounded buttons (borderRadius: 12 or 16).
Implement subtle hover effects on React Native Web using Pressable hovered state if possible, or standard scale animations on press.
Include micro-animations (like a gentle scale down on press) for touch interactions.
